tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Search the jwatte.com blog (over 1,000 articles on SEO, accessibility, AI search, website security, small business, money and real estate) by keyword. Returns up to `limit` articles, best match first: title, publication date, link and summary.

tools.name: get_book_info
tools.description: Catalog details for one of J.A. Watte's six books by slug: title, subtitle, page count, format, listed price, a short factual summary, Amazon link and companion website. Slugs: w2trap, condotrap, resaletrap, 97launch, 20agency, 100network. Prices are catalog values, not a live retailer lookup.
